title: Donut begins operating
description: Donut began offering a consumer crypto savings and yield application.
notes: Launch date is approximate and recorded at year-level.

title: Genesis redemption halt affects Donut accounts
description: Genesis Global Capital suspended redemptions, and Donut users were unable to access normal account withdrawals through the Genesis-linked yield arrangement.
notes: The Genesis halt date is confirmed; Donut-specific account effects are supported by contemporaneous Donut-related reporting.

title: Genesis lending entities file Chapter 11
description: Genesis Global Capital and related lending entities entered Chapter 11, moving the underlying Donut counterparty exposure into a court-supervised restructuring process.
notes: Donut itself did not file Chapter 11; this event records the underlying counterparty process affecting Donut users.

title: Donut announces discontinuation
description: Donut announced that it would discontinue the service after the Genesis creditor term sheet became public.
notes: The announcement date is supported by a contemporaneous reproduction of Donut's user communication.

title: Donut mobile app removal deadline
description: Donut stated that its mobile app would be removed by 31 March 2023 and that user accounts had been moved to a web dashboard for balances, statements and future withdrawals.
notes: The date is the announced app-removal deadline and is used as the platform end date.

title: Genesis begins creditor distributions
description: Genesis completed its restructuring and began distributing digital assets and U.S. dollars to creditors under its Chapter 11 plan.
notes: This is an underlying Genesis distribution milestone; reviewed sources do not establish a universal Donut-specific recovery or completion date.

title: Finblox begins operating
description: Finblox launched as a custodial crypto yield and rewards platform.
notes: Launch date is recorded at year-level.

title: Finblox restricts withdrawals and pauses rewards
description: Finblox imposed a $1,500 monthly withdrawal limit and paused rewards while assessing its exposure to Three Arrows Capital.
notes: This was a severe restriction rather than a complete platform-wide withdrawal shutdown.

title: Finblox raises limits and restores selected rewards
description: Finblox increased withdrawal limits and restored reward functions for selected assets after its initial 3AC-related restrictions.
notes: The partial restoration did not resolve all counterparty or customer-outcome questions.

title: Finblox services reported closed
description: Finblox was reported to have closed services on 7 July 2025 after telling users that changing market dynamics and decline of the CeFi staking model made continued operation impractical.
notes: The closure date is based on reporting that cited company emails; no directly accessible first-party closure page was found.

title: FINBLOX LIMITED is dissolved
description: The United Kingdom corporate register recorded final dissolution of FINBLOX LIMITED following voluntary strike-off proceedings.
notes: Corporate dissolution corroborates an ended operating state, but the exact relationship to all Finblox customer entities and contracts is not assumed.
